mapper.select: SELECT biz_area_id as "bizAreaId", biz_area_nm as "bizAreaNm", biz_area_desc as "bizAreaDesc", parent_id as "parentId", sort_order as "sortOrder", use_yn as "useYn" FROM tb_biz_area WHERE COALESCE(use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_order, biz_area_nm

WITH RECURSIVE T (ID, LVL, PATH, SORT_PATH) AS ( SELECT S.SUBJ_AREA_ID, 1, S.SUBJ_AREA_NM::text, lpad(COALESCE(S.SORT_ORDER, 0)::text, 6, '0') || S.SUBJ_AREA_NM FROM TB_SUBJ_AREA S WHERE COALESCE(S.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND (S.PARENT_ID IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_SUBJ_AREA P WHERE P.SUBJ_AREA_ID = S.PARENT_ID AND COALESCE(P.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y')) UNION ALL SELECT C.SUBJ_AREA_ID, T.LVL + 1, T.PATH || ' > ' || C.SUBJ_AREA_NM, T.SORT_PATH || '/' || lpad(COALESCE(C.SORT_ORDER, 0)::text, 6, '0') || C.SUBJ_AREA_NM FROM TB_SUBJ_AREA C JOIN T ON C.PARENT_ID = T.ID WHERE COALESCE(C.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND T.LVL < 10 ) SELECT S.SUBJ_AREA_ID as "subjAreaId", S.SUBJ_AREA_NM as "subjAreaNm", S.SUBJ_AREA_DESC as "subjAreaDesc", S.PARENT_ID as "parentId", S.SORT_ORDER as "sortOrder", S.USE_YN as "useYn", T.LVL as "level", T.PATH as "path", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_SUBJ_AREA C WHERE C.PARENT_ID = S.SUBJ_AREA_ID AND COALESCE(C.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y') as "childCnt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ O WHERE O.SUBJ_AREA_ID = S.SUBJ_AREA_ID AND COALESCE(O.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y') as "tableCnt" FROM T JOIN TB_SUBJ_AREA S ON S.SUBJ_AREA_ID = T.ID ORDER BY T.SORT_PATH
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_biz_area (biz_area_id, biz_area_nm, biz_area_desc, parent_id, sort_order, use_yn, cret_user_id, cret_dt, aprv_status, aprv_user_id, aprv_dt) VALUES (#{bizAreaId}, #{bizAreaNm}, #{bizAreaDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{parentId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sortOrder, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 'Y', #{userId}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'APPROVED', #{userId}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) ON CONFLICT (biz_area_id) DO UPDATE SET biz_area_nm = EXCLUDED.biz_area_nm, biz_area_desc = EXCLUDED.biz_area_desc, parent_id = EXCLUDED.parent_id, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, updt_user_id = EXCLUDED.cret_user_id, updt_dt = to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')

INSERT INTO tb_subj_area (subj_area_id, subj_area_nm, subj_area_desc, parent_id, sort_order, use_yn, cret_user_id, cret_dt, aprv_status, aprv_user_id, aprv_dt) VALUES (#{subjAreaId}, #{subjAreaNm}, #{subjAreaDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{parentId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sortOrder, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 'Y', #{userId}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'APPROVED', #{userId}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) ON CONFLICT (subj_area_id) DO UPDATE SET subj_area_nm = EXCLUDED.subj_area_nm, subj_area_desc = EXCLUDED.subj_area_desc, parent_id = EXCLUDED.parent_id, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, updt_user_id = EXCLUDED.cret_user_id, updt_dt = to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_biz_area SET use_yn = 'N' WHERE biz_area_id = #{value}
UPDATE tb_subj_area SET use_yn = 'N' WHERE subj_area_id = #{value}
mapper.select: SELECT M.DM_ID as "dmId", M.DM_NM as "dmNm", O.OBJ_OWNER as "objOwner", O.OBJ_NM as "objNm", O.OBJ_NM_KR as "objNmKr" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ O JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL M ON M.DM_ID = O.DM_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE O.SUBJ_AREA_ID = #{value} AND COALESCE(O.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY M.DM_NM, O.OBJ_OWNER, O.OBJ_NM
SELECT SUBJ_AREA_ID FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ WHERE DM_ID = #{dmId} AND OBJ_OWNER = #{objOwner} AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ SET SUBJ_AREA_ID = #{subjAreaId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE DM_ID = #{dmId} AND OBJ_OWNER = #{objOwner} AND OBJ_NM = #{objNm}
